title: Villager Autotrade
description: Villagers automatically execute their trades using items from chests or barrels placed above and below them. Shift + right-click any villager to enable trades and set priority. Perfect for fully automated trading farms
body:
## Initial release

  First public release for Minecraft 1.21.11.

  ### Features
  - Per-villager auto-trade configuration via shift + right-click
  - Input chest above the villager + output chest below
  - Trade priority ordering with ↑↓ arrows
  - Per-trade enable/disable
  - Natural trade restock through villager workstation usage
  - Works on both singleplayer and dedicated servers (Fabric)
